$comment: p15-oracle-093: e2e scripts 12-22 of MQ-e2e (`ls scripts/cmux-next/*-e2e.py scripts/cmux-next/*-e2e.sh`, sorted), each converted to a case of this suite or excluded with a reason (p15-oracle.md section 5, item 4). The scripts stay; each case's first step names its script. `fix` is the commit that made the behavior the case checks, `parent` that commit's parent: the case's acceptance is a Failure on `parent`. `catches` names the step (before the colon) that should show the bug there. One file per batch, as _scripts-094.json, so the batches (092-097) never edit the same file; oracle.py skips `_` files. The suite's coverage.json (p15-oracle-092) counts these scripts once the batches have landed.
red_on_parent: not run: each parent predates the debug.oracle.* methods (they came with e0c736692e5, 2026-10-26), so driver_app refuses the launch (no-oracle-methods) before the first step. The fleet runs each case on its parent with oracle.py diff --overlay once p15-oracle-202 lands; until then `catches` is the expected failing step, not an observed one.

scripts/cmux-next/color-transition-e2e.p.excluded: samples the presented backdrop and terminal colors as fast as the socket answers and checks recorded window pixels for blend steps (OKLab distance per frame, retarget, Liquid Glass): oracle runs have animations off (section 3B), snapshot-v1 has no theme or color facet, and frame smoothness is the motion-on switch arm and perf-lead benches, not a state checkpoint

scripts/cmux-next/default-theme-e2e.py.excluded: asserts the applied Ghostty background and every window's chrome color (debug.themes) after debug.appearance flips the app's appearance: snapshot-v1 has no theme or appearance facet, and a cli `app call debug.themes` step's expect compares the whole reply (window numbers, edge-fade geometry); converts when a themes facet lands

scripts/cmux-next/dock-split-pane-e2e.py.catches: dock: column.dock answers move-tab-to-column failed, so expect ok fails
